_module.description: The Official Internet.bs Registrar Module. Get an account here: https://internetbs.net/newaccount.html
_module.description_testmode: Check this checkbox if you want to connect to the test server
_module.description_feat_it_hide_whois: Tick this box if you want to hide the information in the public whois for Admin/Billing/Technical contacts (.it)
_module.description_feat_renew_on_transfer: Tick this box if you want to add renewal after transferring .de and .nl domain
_module.description_feat_dnssec: Enables DNSSEC configuration on Client Area
_module.description_feat_auto_fields: Automatically add the include statement in dist.additionalfields.php. After WHMCS' cron, we check if the include statement is present. If not, it is added to the file accordingly. This feature is a temporary workaround until the refactoring of the additional fields mechanism of this module. As upgrading WHMCS is resetting the file in question, this feature should be handy. Read the documentation.
_module.description_feat_validate_fields: Run additional domain fields validation on Shopping Cart Checkout.
_module.description_feat_sync_idprotection: Include Synchronizing TLD Settings in Registrar TLD Sync regarding Id Protection Support.
_module.description_feat_dep_notification: Please chose a department, if you want to have a ticket opened in case of errors returned by our API.
_module.description_feat_validation:
Click on Save for testing your connection to the configured Internet.bs Backend System. Only in case it fails, an error will be shown.
